messages:
Priya: Who wants the last blueberry muffin in the kitchen? :blueberry: :raised_hand:
Liam: Not me, allergic to blueberries :sweat_smile:
Noah: I'll take it if it hasn't been offered to the coffee machine gods yet
Zoe: Leave it for the intern. jk. but also :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Priya: Also — quick one-liner challenge: best two-word life-hack? drop yours below :tada:
Liam: Battery saver
Noah: Inbox zero
Zoe: Plant whisperer
Jen: Label mugs (seriously)
Sam: Snack bribe
Priya: Bonus office rule: if you microwave fish, you owe everyone cookies :cookie:
Jen: Pro tip: put a post-it on shared stuff: `Name | Dept | Date` — less mystery jars
Zoe: Kudos to Sam for fixing the coffee machine yesterday, legend status :pray: @Sam
Sam: thanks! it just needed a gentle threat and a screwdriver :hammer_and_wrench:
LunchBot: POLL — Lunch ideas for today: 1) Sushi 2) Tacos 3) Salad — vote with :one: :two: :three:
Noah: :two: (tacos please)
Liam: :three: if tacos lose, salad it is ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
Priya: Alright taco lovers, meet at 12:15. Whoever brings napkins gets my eternal gratitude :sparkles:
Zoe: I'll bring extra napkins and petty stickers for people who forget names on mugs :stuck_out_tongue:
